text:
dana: Heads up — we're seeing a concentrated spike of NVIDIA Xid errors in the us-west-2 A100 pool. Mostly Xid 31, some Xid 79. Started ~08:10 UTC. Affected jobs are long-context chat (>8k tokens) on llama-2-70b-chat fp16.
infra-bot: alert: gpu-xid-rate high on pool=a100-uswest2 count=48 window=1h
omar: Which job config? batch size, seq len, model variant?
dana: static batch=8, kvcache ON, typical request token_len ~10k (trimming off history sometimes). model=llama-2-70b-chat-v2-fp16
sophie: Can you paste dmesg /kern logs from one of the nodes with errors? Xid 31 often shows up as GPU page fault / illegal memory access.
dana: dmesg snippet from node a100-uw2-07:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 31, pid=4123, GPU=0000:af:00: Enqueued kernel for too long
[ 12345.678905] NVRM: Xid details: 0x0000007f
```
Count in last hour: Xid31=42, Xid79=6 (prom query below)
```
sum(rate(nvidia_driver_xid_total{pool="a100-uswest2"}[1h])) by (xid_code)
```
mike: Xid 31 commonly maps to a firmware/driver kernel issue or an illegal memory access from the process (kernel table). 79 can be a channel timeout or multi-engine conflict; we've seen 79 crop up with heavy KV cache churn.
kevin: Can we correlate per-job GPU metrics? e.g. memory allocation spikes and pci errors when requests hit >8k tokens.
omar: Run this to pull per-pod GPU mem usage around events:
```
promql: max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{pod=~"runner-.*"}[15m])
join on(pod) rate(nvidia_driver_xid_total[15m])
```
sophie: Also check ECC counters and xid counters directly on the card:
```
ssh node
sudo nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,MEMORY,DIAG
# or nv-hostengine logs: sudo cat /proc/driver/nvidia/diag/*
```
mike: Ran ECC check on a100-uw2-07 -> hardware ECC errors: 2 correctable ECC events (last 24h). Not huge but suspicious when combined with memory pressure.
dana: Repro plan: spin same model on single card with sequence=12k, batch=1, loop. I can run on a staging node.
kevin: Before full drain, try throttling request max length at the API gateway to 8192 and enable fallback to a smaller-context model. That will reduce immediate exposure without losing capacity.
omar: If node-level repro fails, we'll likely need node drain+replace. Recommended steps:
- cordon node: `kubectl cordon a100-uw2-07`
- evict pods gracefully: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
- run vendor diag and burn-in memtest
- if persistent, RMA/replace card
sophie: Also capture debug dump if repro hits Xid: `sudo nvidia-debugdump -l` and collect `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and `dmesg` timeline.
dana: Cost note: draining 6 nodes in that pool reduces available GPUs by ~9% during business hours; replacing on-demand will be ~$420/day extra if we spin up on-demand fallback capacity. Prefer rolling approach.
mike: We saw a similar pattern last quarter — rolling replacement of 2 nodes/week while limiting seq_len solved it without big cost spike.
kevin: I'll add a temporary routing policy to route long-context (>8k) traffic to eu-west-1 if latency SLA allows. That buys time for triage.
omar: Action items:
- dana -> run repro on staging with seq=12k and attach debugdump if Xid reproduces (due: 2h)
- sophie -> collect ECC + firmware versions from affected nodes and open vendor ticket if multiple cards show correctable ECC (due: 4h)
- kevin -> implement API max_seq=8192 policy + fallback model (due: 30m)
- mike -> prepare rolling drain plan and cost estimate for replacing up to 6 nodes (due: EOD)
infra-bot: created issue INFRA-2147: "us-west-2 A100 Xid 31/79 correlation with long-context workloads" assigned to eng-infra
dana: starting repro run now on staging-rc1, will post logs if hit. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
omar: Good. If repro shows Xid 31 consistently, we should schedule an emergency firmware/driver upgrade window but coordinate with product for potential rollbacks.
sophie: FYI firmware on affected nodes: 24.21.13.1234, driver 535.86.05
mike: Noted — we upgraded drivers two weeks ago. Put that in the vendor ticket; possible regression.
kevin: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and tag me if we need cross-region routing changed live."
